entry.name: meter~
entry.description: Use the meter~ object to monitor any signal in the range -1 and 1 (other signals should be scaled first).

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Click and drag to reorient the meter display
messages.description: When the patcher window is unlocked, you can reorient afrom horizontal to vertical by dragging its resize area and changing its shape.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Set the meter to display a value
messages.description: A float value will set the meter to react as though a signal with equal amplitude peak-value has been passed to its input. Corresponding LEDs will light up and the peak-level value will be passed out the outlet (0.0 will show silence, 0.0 through 1.0 will light up to any but the overload LED, and anything above 1.0 will light all LEDs including overload).

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Set the meter to display a value
messages.description: Converted to. A value will set the meter to react as though a signal with equal amplitude peak-value has been passed to its input. Corresponding LEDs will light up and the peak-level value will be passed out the outlet (0.0 will show silence, 0.0 through 1.0 will light up to any but the overload LED, and anything above 1.0 will light all LEDs including overload).

messages.name: signal
messages.description: The peak amplitude of the incoming signal is displayed by the LEDs of the on-screen level meter. When a multichannel signal is received, the peak amplitude of each channel will be displayed.

outlets.digest: Peak Value For Each Metering Interval
